# VELQIRIS MCP Release Gate — Chitara Trading

> Deterministic, zero-cloud GitHub Actions release gate for Node.js 20+ MCP stdio servers. The free Action produces PASS / REVIEW / FAIL evidence without sending source code or captured output to a VELQIRIS service.

## Canonical links
- Documentation and demonstrations: https://genesiscode2026.github.io/velqiris/
- Public repository: https://github.com/genesiscode2026/velqiris
- Free Action: `uses: genesiscode2026/velqiris@v1`
- Commercial self-hosted bundle: https://x402git.com/genesiscode2026/genesis-mcp-production-readiness
- Public X402 manifest: https://x402git.com/api/label/genesiscode2026/genesis-mcp-production-readiness
- X402 payment endpoint: https://x402git.com/api/r/genesiscode2026/genesis-mcp-production-readiness
- Security contact: mailto:chitara.trading@proton.me

## Free public gate
Eight runtime checks: `PROC_START`, `PROTO_INIT`, `TOOLS_SCHEMA`, `TOOL_RISK_REVIEW`, `UNKNOWN_TOOL`, `CONCURRENCY`, `PROTOCOL_PURITY`, and `CAPTURE_BOUNDS`. Outputs: `gate-summary.json`, `gate-summary.md`, and the Action disposition.

## Commercial bundle
Adds runtime secret-exposure detection, ten redaction classes, five bounded static source rules plus secret-pattern checks, `report.json`, `report.md`, `manifest.sha256.json`, a self-hosted composite Action, and a Chitara Trading commercial internal-use license.

`manifest.sha256.json` is a checksum manifest. It is not a third-party attestation or cryptographic signature over the ZIP archive.

## Exact scope
VELQIRIS evaluates observable local stdio behavior and bounded source patterns. It is not a penetration test, formal compliance certification, SBOM/dependency audit, or guarantee of zero vulnerabilities.

## Agent purchase flow
1. Read the public manifest and product page.
2. Request the X402 payment endpoint and inspect its HTTP 402 payment requirements.
3. Pay the quoted USDC amount on the advertised Base network only after verifying the recipient and current offer.
4. Fetch the authorized release and verify the delivered SHA-256 evidence manifest.
